scope: A snapshot of the rights categories recorded on source and reader records in this built package. These counts are not a legal opinion or a worldwide rights determination.

sources.interpretation: A source record may describe a catalogue, bibliography, webpage, scan, or text. Its category does not grant reuse rights to any linked reader or media.

readers.interpretation: Reader categories describe the rights evidence recorded for each bundled text layer. Consult its exact notice and linked sources before reuse; archive canon links do not establish rights, edition identity, completeness, or accuracy.

classification_limits.open_license: A license is stated in the record; its exact terms and scope still control.
classification_limits.public_domain_claimed: A source or record claims public-domain status; the archive has not established a worldwide legal conclusion.
classification_limits.permission_limited: Use is recorded with permission or other specific limits; follow the detailed notice.
classification_limits.all_rights_reserved: The source records an all-rights-reserved notice; no broader permission is inferred.
classification_limits.mixed: The record contains differing rights statements, jurisdictions, or components that must remain distinct.
classification_limits.unknown: The record does not establish reuse terms. Unknown is neither permission nor a finding that reuse is forbidden.

interpretation_limits: A source-record count is not a count of works, translations, or reader texts.
A reader-record count is not a count of unique books or complete editions; several records may describe separate language or edition layers.
An open-source software license or metadata license does not relicense scripture, translations, scans, images, or other third-party content.
